prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["What kind of desktop companion do you prefer?", "Select a personality style to narrow down the best pet options for your workspace.", "Quiet Focus, Playful Assistant, Active Mascot", "Continue to Pets"]
1: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion!", "Try interacting with your new pet right now before finishing setup.", "Live desktop pet preview box", "Try dragging, right-clicking for settings, or clicking to talk"]
2: ["Finalizing Desktop Setup", "Your pet is getting ready for your desktop environment.", "Building animations & desktop assets...", "Launch Pet"]
3: []
4: ["Select Your Workspace Vibe", "Swipe to explore how your pet will interact with you during work."]
5: ["Your official pet adoption certificate is almost complete!", "Official Pet Adoption Verified", "Step 3 of 4 Complete"]
6: ["Tip: You can hide your desktop pet anytime using the taskbar menu.", "Estimated loading time: ~15 seconds"]
7: ["Important: Sign in with your existing Google/Apple account to restore existing pets and avoid accidental account resets."]
8: ["Pet not appearing on screen? Check your system tray (Windows) or Menu Bar (Mac) to toggle pet visibility."]
9: ["How do you want your pet to live on your desktop?", "Choose your primary goal for a tailored onboarding journey.", "Interactive Desktop Friend, Quiet Background Widget", "Continue"]
